messages:
Ava (CEO): Morning all — quick executive snapshot.
Ava (CEO): Key points:
• Hosting revenue +12% w/w; API p95 latency 160ms (down from 210ms) — small wins from kernel tweaks.
• Dedicated pilot onboarded 3 customers; throughput improved ~18% on p2-series.
• Launch: 'Burst Capacity' beta ready next Wed. Docs + signup: https://redwood.ai/docs/burst-capacity
• Policy: Data retention default for logs moving to 90 days (from 180). Security & compliance ok'd.
Ava (CEO): Asks: 1) Eng: final perf checklist for launch; 2) Product: finalize pricing tiers; 3) CS: prepare pilot comms.
Raj (CTO): Great. Engineering is tracking a flaky mem-leak in the batching layer — investigating. ETA EOD Tue.
Maya (VP Product): Pricing draft posted: https://redwood.ai/sheet/pricing-draft — feedback welcome by Mon EOD.
Jared (Head of Eng): Note on perf checklist: need fallback routing tested across regions and canary plan. I'll post checklist before EOD.
Lina (Head, CS): I'll draft pilot comms and a short FAQ. Prefer release note + one-pager.
OpsBot: Deploy window scheduled: 2026-03-30 02:00-03:00 UTC — will run smoke tests and rollback on error.
Raj (CTO): Quick ask — can we get a table of p95 by region? I want to confirm SLOs before canary.
Ava (CEO): Raj, please work with SRE; cc @Maya @Jared. If we hit >250ms p95 in any region, postpone canary.
Maya (VP Product): Acknowledged. I'll coordinate pricing email with Lina once checklist is up.
Jared (Head of Eng): +1. Also adding a test for KV cache warmup to the canary runbook.
Ava (CEO): Thanks team — overall good momentum. We'll sync on Monday exec review; bring any blockers.
Lina (Head, CS): :thumbsup:
Jared (Head of Eng): :rocket:
